response.overview: To contact Delta Airlines customer service in Italian, you can call +39-800 | 974-732. Representatives can assist you with bookings, flight changes, refunds, baggage, check-in, and other travel-related inquiries. Please have your booking reference (PNR) ready to ensure faster and more efficient service. To reach a Delta Airlines representative from Italy, you can call customer service at +39-800 | 974-732. This service provides support for reservations, ticket modifications, baggage, and general flight information. You can also contact Delta Airlines from Italy via their general call center at +39-800 | 974-732, the dedicated line for bookings and assistance in Rome and Milan at +39-800 | 974-732, or the direct line for Bologna at +39-800 | 974-732 (available daily from 08:00 to 20:00). Additionally, you can reach out through Delta Airlines' official social media channels or the company's website.
